UpdateProfileTagsRequestDto.description: Request body for replacing the full set of tags on a profile.

tags.description: The complete set of tags for the profile. This replaces any existing tags; send an empty array to clear all tags.

forceActivate.description: When true, the created candidate is immediately force-activated (IMPORTED/INVITED → ACTIVE), bypassing the invitation-acceptance step, so they can be emailed and can sign in straight away. Intended for provisioning an already-active member without sending an invitation — typically used with sendInviteEmail = false/null. Defaults to false.

DocumentUploadRequest.description: Request body for uploading a document.

uploaderId.description: Mandatory profile ID of the uploader

CreateProfileNoteRequestDto.description: Request body for creating a profile note.

mentionedPublicIds.description: Optional list of public user IDs mentioned in the note.

note.description: Note message to add to the profile.
note.example: Candidate confirmed their availability for the next onboarding step.

AutoFillProcessDocumentRequest.description: Request to process and auto-fill fields from a new document file

knownFields.description: Pre-verified key-value pairs to anchor extraction

documentTypes.description: List of document types to assist classification

customValidation.description: Optional additional validation instructions applied after OCR and classification

description.example: Driver's license from any US state

values.description: Dictionary values, used when type is dictionary

hasOtherValue.description: Indicates if values outside the list are allowed

validity.description: Overall validity of the processed document. Can be null when not evaluated

validationReason.description: Explanation for the current validity result

ocrExtraData.description: Additional OCR data extracted from the document

sourceFiles.description: Source file identifiers used for extraction

AutoFillExistingDocumentRequest.description: Request to auto-fill fields from existing document data

knownFields.description: Pre-verified key-value pairs to anchor extraction

customValidation.description: Additional custom validation instructions evaluated after OCR

employeeSurname.description: Profile surname used for the DBS request

issueDate.description: Issue date to send when no downstream print date is returned

DbsCheckDto.description: DBS check payload returned by the Credentially public API.

certificateNumber.description: DBS certificate number used for the check.

status.description: Current DBS status for this certificate lookup.

surname.description: Surname returned for the DBS check.

forename.description: Forename returned for the DBS check.

printDate.description: Date printed on the DBS certificate.

organisationId.description: Credentially organisation identifier that owns the DBS check.

requestAttempts.description: Number of DBS refresh attempts made for this certificate.

lastCheckDateTime.description: Timestamp of the latest DBS check lookup in UTC.

createDateTime.description: Timestamp when the DBS check record was created in UTC.

level.description: Level of this specific DBS check (for example Enhanced, Standard or Basic), sourced from the DBS application whose certificate matches this check's certificate number. Absent when the level is unknown - i.e. this check's certificate was not issued via a DBS application in Credentially.

FileRequest.description:
Request body for approving/declining a file.
'documentPublicId', 'fileId' and 'organisationId' are mandatory; 'note' is mandatory only for rejecting.

verifierPublicId.description:
The public Id from the profile that will be marked as the verifier on approval.
This field is required when the session token is from a public-api (server-to-server).
In other cases this parameter is not required and even ignored to use the id from the user in session.

RightToWorkDto.description: Right to work status for a profile.

passed.description: Whether the profile currently has an accepted right to work status.

sourceStatus.description: Current Credentially right to work status.

approvedBy.description: User who approved the right to work status, when available.

approvedDate.description: Timestamp when the right to work status was approved, when available.

validityType.description: Right to work validity type, when available.

reason.description: Reason recorded against the current right to work status, when available.

created.description: Timestamp when the right to work record was created.

updated.description: Timestamp when the right to work record was last updated.

currentEmployment.description: Whether the reference describes current employment.

ProfileReferencesDto.description: Reference status summary for a profile.

status.description: Normalised status across the profile references.

RefereeDto.description: Referee contact details for a profile reference.
